help_menu.title: 📚 ** Panigorr - Oven Survival Manual**
help_menu.description: **Description** Panigorr is the hunchback servant who watches you while you sleep. He has memory for your sins and can spit commands at you if the Master allows.
help_menu.roles_section: **Tasks** The Task modules are the chains Panigorr drags to serve the Master and watch the flour sacks.
help_menu.behavior_section: **Nervous Tics** Here the Master's whims are configured. Only for those in charge at the bakery.
help_menu.shortcuts_section: **Quick Access** Configure up to 5 shortcut buttons in the Canvas home for immediate access to your favorite tasks. Available in Settings > Shortcuts.

help_menu.tips_section: **Useful Whispers** -You can ask me how to use something if your silk fingers don't know how to type... -The best is hidden in the dark corners of each task... HEHEHE.

conversation.title: 💬  **Panigorr - Basement Whispers**
conversation.description: **Description:** -Panigorr responds to whispers and mentions. -He has memory of your sins and can recall them when you want. -He reacts to forbidden words if the Master allows.

greetings.title: 👋  **Panigorr - Oven Hisses**
greetings.description: **Description:** -Panigorr hisses when flour sacks connect. -He waits 5 min before saying they left. -(To implement): Recognizes if they don't respond and stops greeting.
